name: Littlestone Dimension / $k$-Block Littlestone Dimension
details: Every $k$-block shattered tree is an ordinary shattered Littlestone tree.
proof: The $k$-block condition only restricts the coordinate labels allowed in an ordinarily shattered Littlestone tree. Thus every tree counted by $\mathrm B_k(\mathcal H)$ is counted by $\mathrm L(\mathcal H)$, and $\mathrm L(\mathcal H)\ge\mathrm B_k(\mathcal H)$ for every fixed $k>2$.
witness_verification: For #classes/halfintervals with n>=4, the established endpoint values or bounds, in parameter order, are $\lfloor\log_2n\rfloor$ and $1$. The first parameter divided by one plus the second tends to infinity. Thus no reverse affine-linear bound holds. See the database-owned endpoint value proofs. The block size k>2 is fixed throughout the family.
